announcement.goals.fangroles.poisoner: Use your exclusive poisoned weapons to poison them!
item.fangroles.poison_needle.tooltip:
Right-click a living player to inject poison
30s initial cooldown / 45s cooldown
Reusable
item.fangroles.catalyst.tooltip:
On a poisoned player: poison takes effect in 5s
Also resets the poison needle cooldown
On air or a non-poisoned player: only resets the cooldown
item.fangroles.poison_gas_bomb.tooltip:
Right-click to throw a poison gas bomb
The gas spreads through open space
It can bypass partial blocks such as slabs and stairs
5s inside the gas poisons you
The gas disperses after 30s
replay.poisoned.fangroles.gas_bomb.by: %s inhaled poison gas released by %s and was poisoned
